events.title: Regional health boards and community health councils added to FOIPPA's "health care body" class, in force on assent

evidence.locator: SBC 1995 c. 53 (Miscellaneous Statutes Amendment Act (No. 3), 1995), PDF p. 1 / printed p. 925 (assented to July 13, 1995), PDF p. 4 / printed p. 928 s. 14 (Schedule 1, "health care body", new paras. (g) and (h)), PDF p. 22 / printed p. 946 s. 55 (s. 14 not among the provisions deferred to regulation)

events.interpretation_notes: A class date, not a creation date. Section 14 adds boards designated under Health Authorities Act s. 4(1) and councils designated under s. 6(1) to the FOIPPA Schedule 1 definition of health care body; it commenced on Royal Assent (the official 1995 Table of Statutes, root source R4R-081, PDF p. 80, lists the amendment without a deferred date; the RS1996 FOIPPA historical table cites 1995-53-14, R4H-018 PDF pp. 37, 55). Related subjects are the boards and councils the atlas holds as designated by that day; for each, coverage starts no earlier than both this day and its own designation, and later-designated bodies enter on designation. It does not cover the community health services societies of 1997, is distinct from the 3 November 1994 hospital and regional-hospital-district class date (root module), and is a scrutiny relation, not ministry accountability. The original Health Authorities Act 1993 c. 47 made no FOIPPA amendment (R4H-017, s. 18 is its only consequential amendment). The April 1997 FOIPPA dates belong to the Hospital Appeal Board name in Schedule 2, not to this class.
